title: Words that do not belong at the dinner table

copy.heading: Words that do not belong at the dinner table

blocks.text: The following words and phrases are for the clubhouse. Please leave them there.

rows: "I'm about to talk for twenty minutes."
"I'm going to write to the committee again."

blocks.label: Case notes (Sue), Day 9
blocks.text: Asked him what he thought of Alfie's swimming badge. He said "Not bad, not bad," then told me about Keith's handicap. He didn't know Alfie had been swimming. He's been going since March.
